start: A gym open in HQ, card "Owner lost their sign-in", HQ signed in within 15 minutes

steps.action: Call the gym's own number; tick "I called the gym’s own number and the owner confirmed"
user_sees: "Call the gym’s own number first. ... The owner’s old PIN stops working; they set a new one after signing in with this code."
must_not: A code made without the tick

steps.action: Press "Make a new sign-in code"
user_sees: The code card "For <owner>, <mobile>." with "Copy the message"
must_not: The owner's old PIN still working

steps.action: Type why, press "Sign out everywhere", confirm "Sign every phone and computer of <gym> out now?"
user_sees: "<n> devices signed out."
" This gym also has an old browser key; tell Claude." when one exists
must_not: A device of another gym signed out

steps.action: Press "Make a new sign-in code" without the tick
user_sees: "Tick that you called the gym’s own number first."
must_not: A code made

steps.action: Press it with an HQ sign-in older than 15 minutes
user_sees: "For this, sign in again first (it must be within the last 15 minutes)."
must_not: A code made

steps.action: Make a sixth code in one hour
user_sees: "Too many codes for this gym in the last hour. Wait a little."
must_not: A sixth code

start: Sign-out with no reason, then with one

steps.action: Press "Sign out everywhere" with an empty reason
user_sees: "Write a reason (at least a few words)."
must_not: Devices signed out with no reason

steps.action: Type a reason and press again
user_sees: "<n> devices signed out."; a second press says "0 devices signed out."
must_not: A count that includes devices already signed out

steps.action: Read what is kept
user_sees: The code is not kept: "It is not kept anywhere: copy it now."; the log keeps the last 4 mobile digits and the reason
must_not: The code in the log
The code sent to anyone but the owner on the gym's number

start: The owner lost their PIN or phone and called MettleUp

steps.action: Answer MettleUp's call on the gym's own number and confirm
user_sees: A WhatsApp with the new sign-in code
must_not: A code sent to the number that called in, if it is not the gym's

steps.action: Open the admin app, type the mobile and the code, set a new PIN
user_sees: The admin app open; the new PIN works
must_not: The old PIN still working

start: The owner reports a lost phone

steps.action: HQ signs the gym out everywhere
user_sees: The lost phone's admin app goes to the sign-in screen on its next call
must_not: The lost phone still able to change records

steps.action: Sign in again on the new phone
user_sees: The admin app open
must_not: The owner locked out for good

steps.action: Type the old PIN
user_sees: A refusal
must_not: The old PIN accepted

steps.action: Type the code after 30 minutes
user_sees: A refusal
must_not: The code accepted

start: Signed in on a laptop when HQ signs the gym out

steps.action: Press any save on the laptop
user_sees: The sign-in screen
must_not: The save done on an ended session
Typed work lost without a word

steps.action: Open the MettleUp access list in the admin app
user_sees: "reset owner sign-in" or "sign out" with the reason
must_not: The code shown there

start: A desk person signed in when HQ signs the gym out everywhere

steps.action: Press any button that saves
user_sees: The sign-in screen
must_not: The save done on an ended session

steps.action: Sign in again
user_sees: The admin app open
must_not: The desk person locked out with no way back

start: A desk person asks MettleUp for a code

steps.action: Call MettleUp asking for a code
user_sees: HQ can only make a code for the owner; the owner adds desk people
must_not: A desk person given an owner code

steps.action: Open the admin app next morning
user_sees: The sign-in screen once; after signing in, normal work
must_not: A loop back to sign-in after a good sign-in

steps.action: Look for the reason
user_sees: No HQ reason shown to desk people
must_not: The owner's new code shown to a desk person
